slice: bounded context-cache cardinality, retained-memory, eviction, and disposal A/B

environment.dependencyResolution: The worktree node_modules symlink resolves through the existing shared install; the fixture links the Crumbs package directly to the worktree package root.

protocol.method: scratch-only bounded LRU over esbuild contexts; all cache hits call rebuild(), misses create a context, and eviction/close await dispose()
protocol.hotWorkingSet: up to four most-recently scanned cloned entries
protocol.fixture: Cloned Crumbs recipe entries share one theme dependency; entry edits alternate borderRadius 8 and 128.
protocol.memorySampling: Node process.memoryUsage() and read-only ps RSS snapshots for esbuild service children at baseline, post-cold-scan, post-hot-workload, post-context-disposal, and post-service-stop.
protocol.outputParity: Every distinct entry/value result is compared after disposing cached contexts with a fresh @vanilla-extract/integration compile by exact generated JavaScript SHA-256 and normalized input list.
protocol.rawReceiptCompaction: Per-process output hashes and a hash of the exact combined receipts are retained; normalized input lists are stored once per entry-count and entry and are cross-checked exactly across processes. Output hashes are intentionally not compared across workers because Vanilla Extract includes each unique temporary fixture path.

limits: The stylesheet-count and hot-entry workload is synthetic; it is not a captured Metro transform trace from a representative Expo application.
RSS snapshots do not isolate live per-context bytes and may reflect allocator high-water behavior.
The scratch LRU does not qualify the complete Crumbs native transformer, Metro worker shutdown, Node 22 host budget, Hermes, device rendering, Android, or release readiness.
No production cache, public API, approved performance threshold, or baseline changed.

result.decision: Do not add a production context cache from this synthetic trace. Capacity 4 is a candidate for the next full-transform and Metro lifecycle A/B only.
result.nextRecommendedSlice: M10.5 full-transform cache integration and Metro worker-lifecycle A/B using a captured Expo Storybook transform trace
